newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee ends in plus column on firmer NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee ends in plus column on firmer NY.

text.p: Robusta coffee futures ended off highs in afternoon trade after riding up on the back of New York as did several other London markets on Wednesday
The benchmark November contract ended $20 up at $1,524 after failing to hold onto a high of $1,527 reached after breaching the technical resistance of $1,520.
"We've seen spec buying in London, probably more in the afternoon than in the morning, a bit of roaster buying and trade selling and origin selling," one trader said.
Traders said a firmer New York market boosted London.
"We basically tried to follow New York a bit," a trader said.
"It has tracked New York this afternoon that is why the arbitrages are wider," another trader said.
Some activity was also centred on switches.
"A reasonable amount on the Nov/Jan, particularly once it did below 60," the trader added.
